tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /rdo rje'i lam la 'jug pa bzhugs/na mo gu ru be/na ma bud+dha dharma saṃ ghe bh+yaḥrigs dang mos pa dag dang bla ma bsten/ /gdams ngag lam dang zung 'ja
༄༅/ /rdo rje'i lam la 'jug pa bzhugs/na mo gu ru be/na ma bud+dha dharma saṃ ghe bh+yaḥrigs dang mos pa dag dang bla ma bsten/ /gdams ngag lam dang zung 'ja

tei:div.tei:p: na mo gu ru be/ na ma bud+dha dharma saṃ ghe bh+yaḥ rigs dang mos pa dag dang bla ma bsten/ /gdams ngag lam dang zung 'jug ces bya ba/ /rdo rje theg pa'i lam bzang sde snod bcas/ /mdor na gnas drug po ni 'di dag go /rigs las chos la mos 'gyur de las kyang*/ /bla ma bsten dang de las gdams ngag nod/ /de don bsgoms pas zung 'jug 'thob 'gyur phyir/ /rim 'di phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rnams kyis dgongs/ /de ltar dgyes pa'i rdo rje'i rtsa rgyud du/ /rdo rje'i rigs bstan las dang lam de bzhin/ /grol ba'i rgyu mtshan gsum gyis mos pa dang*/ /dbang bskur gdams ngag lam dang 'bras bu'i chos/ /rnam bzhi phyi nas rab tu gsal bar bstan/ /ngo bo tha dad nges pa dang*/ /ma nges mchog dang dman pa drug /'di dag rgyu+u yi rgyud yin te/ /rigs kyi nges pa'i tshig tu brjod/ /sems rgyun kun gzhi shes tshogs bcas/ /rlung dang snang ba'i yid lus dang*/ /rang bzhin gyis ni zung 'jug pa/ /rigs kyi ngo bo yin par 'dod/ khams dang mos dang sgrub dang 'bras/ /tha dad dmigs phyir nyan thos dang*/ /rang rgyal pha rol phyin theg dang*/ /'bras bu'i rigs rnams yod par brjod/ /rdo rje'i theg par smon lam btab/ /dbang sogs sos btab 'phel ba'i cha/ /lam la 'dun cing rtsol ba'i las/ /myur 'god sems bskyed 'brel gang nges/ /gzhan dag nges pa ma yin no/ /bde chen theg par legs smon cing*/ /zung 'jug la 'dun bzhi ldan mchog /gsum ldan la sogs dman par brjod/ /sems bcas lus kyang rang bzhin gyis/ /theg pa 'di la rnam par dag /nus ldan 'dra ba sems can kun/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i rigs dang ldan/ / mos pa chung 'bring chen po dang*/ /mchog dang mchog rab bla med drug /yid ches las byung snying rje dang*/ /shes rab dman ldan dge ba'am/ /theg gnyis 'dun pa'i las can te/ /'di ni mos pa dman par brjod/ /sgrol 'dod theg mchog dang las byung*/

/bdag dang gzhan mnyam shes rab dang*/ /gzhan don snying stobs 'bring gyur pa/ /byang chub mchog la mos shing 'dun/ /mos pa 'bring zhes brjod pa ste/ /pha rol phyin dang thun mong yin/ /rgyu ni rdo rje'i theg pa la/ / dang shing smon lam btab gyur pa/ /myur tu sgrol ba'i 'dun pas sad/ /'di ni mos pa chen po'o/ /shin tu myur dang sdug bsngal rgyu/ /'phral du 'gog 'dun dag pa yi/ /gsal snang 'brel 'di lhag par che/ /gsang sngags spyi dang bskyed rim la'o/ /bde chen sdom pa dang 'brel ba/ /yud kyis byang chub thob 'dun cing*/ /mtshan med bde chen grogs bcas pa/ /de 'dra mchog rab rdzogs rim la/ /'bras mthong yid ches sgom byung dang*/ /sprul sku'i gdams ngag thos sogs rgyu/ /'gro kun stong par mngon sum du/ /'jug pa'i lam la 'dun bla med/ /rkyen dang rgyu dang lhan cig byed/ /bla ma rnam pa gsum yin no/ /rkyen ni rdo rje slob dpon dang*/ /rgyu ni lam gyi ye shes yin/ /lhan cig byed pa phyag rgya mo/ /de gsum ngo bo dbye ba dang*/ /bsten tshul gsum du shes par bya/ /ngo bo rdo rje'i lam 'god mdzad/ /dam tshig zlas pa sbyin pa dang*/ /'chad byed man ngag ston pa dang*/ /dbang bskur ba dang las byed pa/ /rnal 'byor can gyi bla ma ste/ / las dang po yi gnas skabs la'o/ /skyon spangs yon tan ldan pa ste/ /slob dpon mtshan nyid bsten tshul sogs/ /rgyud las ji skad gsungs pa bzhin/ / ye shes cung zad brtan pa na/ /rang rgyud rtogs pa'i lha dag dang*/ /brtan nas mkha' 'gro ma mo sogs/ /brtan pa cher thob sprul sku dang*/ /sa bcu pa sogs longs spyod rdzogs/ /rgyu yi ngo bo gong ma yi/ /ye shes gsal bar mtshon nus can/ /ba skyed rim mthar thug ye shes ni/ /dang po'i bla mar blo can 'dod/ / rdzogs rim dngos gzhi'i shes dang po/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i bla ma'o/ /bde ba chen po'i bla ma ni/

/phyag chen las thob zhu bder bsgrags/ /mthong lam dga' ba'i skad cig ma/ /re re'i sngon du 'byung ba de'o/ /nges par 'byin pa'i bla ma ni/ /sa bcu 'og nas gong ma ru/ /'phar byed yan lag bdun ldan yin/ /lam de nyid dang rgyu tshogs rnams/ /goms byed 'di yi bsten tshul yin/ /lhan cig byed pa'i ngo bo ni/ /bde rgyu thun mong min bud med/ /las dang ye shes phyag rgya che/ /ye shes la ni dam tshig dang*/ /brtags pa'i rig ma gnyis su gnas/ / phyag chen rnam bcas rnam med gnyis/ /dang por bde sbyin dbang gi dus/ /smin byed phyag rgya bskyed rim dang*/ /zhu bde 'bras bur byed pa ni/ /rdzogs rim dngos gzhi ma thob par/ /thob nas so skye'i lam du ni/ /rang bzhin bde ba 'bras bur byed/ /spros bral rnam pa'i phyag rgya ni/ /'phags pa'i lam du 'byung ba yin/ /'dzag med bde ba'i don du ni/ /'dod chags stong par bsre zhing bsgom/ /dbang dang dam tshig brtul zhugs dang*/ /g.yo med dang ni zung 'jug dang*/ /nye rgyu ltos med rang nyid dang*/ /'bras bu lam gyi cha rkyen la/ /gdams pa rnam pa bcu zhes bya/ /dkyil 'khor dbang sogs mi dmigs dang*/ 1 /dam tshig la yang gnyis med kyi/ /ye shes kyis ni 'jug pa dang*/ 2 /mtshan bcas mtshan med brtul zhugs kyang*/ /rang bzhin med par shes pas spyod/ 3 /bya la'ang dmigs gtad kun zhig pa'i/ /stong dang bde chen lha skus spyod/ 4 / bde la stong dang stong la bde/ /zung 'jug la yang mtshan med bsgom/ 5 /rang dang phyag rgya ye shes dbang*/ /mnyam pa nyid du gdams pa dang*/ 6 /sgo gsum longs spyod ma chags bzhin/ /ngo bos stong dang ltos med par/ /cho ga'i sbyor bcas dmigs med spyod/ 7 /bdag gi rang bzhin ma dmigs kyang*/ /'gro ba byang chub la brtson cing*/ /bya dang lam gyis bdag mtshon dang*/ 8 /rang bzhin med kyang 'bras bu ni/ /dbyer med yon tan ldan la 'dun/

9 /mngon shes sogs don sgrub cha rkyen/ /nyon mongs bdud sogs stong bde bar/ /shes pas rang bzhin don spyod do/ 10 /lam gyi gzhi dang rkyang pa bsgom/ /bsdus sgom bsdus sgom rab gyur pa/ /lam ni rnam pa bzhi zhes brjod/ /rtse gcig ma gyur par dang ni/ / gyur nas brtan phyir sgom pa dang*/ /yan lag bdun ldan sogs rtsol dang*/ /de yi rdzogs rim rtsol med 'jug /rnam rtog shin tu nub gyur pa'o/ /yan lag bdun dang rdo rje gsum/ /ched du bya bzhi yan lag drug /lam gyi ngo bo dam pa yin/ /'bras bu sku dang ye shes gnyis/ /sku bzhi rdo rje rnam bzhi dang*/ /de yi rang bzhin sku bcu drug /ye shes rnam pa lnga dang ni/ /de nyid bdun du brjod pa yin/ /de skad brjod pa'i dge ba yis/ /'gro ba byang chub myur thob shog /tā ra nā thas sbyar ba ste/ rang lo nyer lnga pa la'o// //dge legs 'phel// zhu dag/ bkra shis// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/rdo rje'i lam la 'jug pa bzhugs/ - PAGE 100 -- PAGE 97 -- PAGE 96 -
